meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会分析蛋白质糖基化:扫描 N-X-S/T 基序找 N-糖基化位点、按 S/T 密度预测 O-糖基化热点、生成消除或新增糖基化位点的突变序列,并提供外部工具与抗体改造策略。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白质序列,要求扫描 N-糖基化位点(如 N-X-S/T)、预测 O-糖基化热点,或涉及抗体工程、治疗性蛋白、疫苗抗原设计时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列的 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T)。
say.note: 返回位点、基序与上下文摘要。

say.text: 把第 120 位天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺,消除该糖基化位点。
预测这条序列的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 按局部 S/T 密度给出候选位点。

howto.what_en: Claude can analyze protein glycosylation: scan for N-X-S/T sequons, predict O-glycosylation hotspots by S/T density, generate mutations that remove or add glycosylation sites, and give tool usage and antibody strategies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user gives a protein sequence and asks to scan N-glycosylation sites, predict O-glycosylation hotspots, or works on antibody, therapeutic protein, or vaccine design.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T).
Mutate Asn at position 120 to Gln to remove the glycosylation site.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this protein sequence.
